newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal hopes to sell Tabaqueira this year.
newsitem.headline: Portugal hopes to sell Tabaqueira this year.

text.p: Under-Secretary for Finance Fernando Teixeira dos Santos said he hoped Portugal could still sell off state tobacco company Tabaqueira this year.
"I hope we will privatise Tabaqueira this year," he told reporters during a special session at the Lisbon bourse for the privatisation of a 13.22 percent stake in Banco Totta e Acores (BTA).
"The Economy Minister has made a big effort to submit his analysis as quickly as possible and I believe that it will be possible for the sale to go ahead this year."
The government plans to sell off a 65 percent stake in Tabaqueira, Portugal's dominant cigarette manufacturer.

Two weeks ago Economy Minister Augusto Mateus referred the privatisation of Tabaqueira to the Competition Council which had 30 days to give an opinion on the likely impact of the sale on the local market.
Mateus then has a further 15 days to consider the bids.

Candidates bidding to buy Tabaqueira are U.S. tobacco giant Philip Morris, in partnership with Portugal's Jorge de Mello group; state-owned Spanish tobacco company Tabacalera, allied to Madeira company Empresa Madeirense de Tabacos, and French group Seita.
